title: A Theory of Everything - Research Collection (2026-10-01), public edition
description:
Public edition of the 1 October 2026 research collection: 7,399 pages. Baird / ZoraASI corpus Parts 1-4 (pp. 5-7,282), containing the 18 September 2026 unified edition (6,926 pp; restored directly from the hash-verified A_Theory_of_Everything_UPDATED_2026-09-18.pdf in github.com/Cbaird26/mqgt-scf-continued), the September 2026 working papers and dated January-March 2026 notes; plus Jennifer Lorraine Nielsen's independently authored preprint The Complex Hopf Fibration as the Canonical Space for Gauge-Gravity Unification (Preprints.org v5, 17 July 2026, DOI 10.20944/preprints202604.0315.v5, CC BY 4.0; pp. 7,284-7,399), reproduced unmodified with attribution.

Withheld: Nielsen's 240-page TUFT manuscript (PhilArchive NIETTU) is cited, not reproduced, because the supplied copy carries no reuse license; a 50-page personal study guide is withheld as personal material.

Rights: the CC BY 4.0 license of this deposit covers the depositor's own material. Third-party work keeps its own terms; see editions/2026-10-01/NOTICE.md in the repository. Source manifests with SHA-256 hashes and page maps are embedded in the PDF as attachments and mirrored in the repository.

Status labels: archival research compilation; not peer reviewed; contains duplicate copies of some working papers and template author placeholders inside the corpus (documented). It does not claim experimental detection of any MQGT-SCF observable.
notes: Draft metadata only. The latest Zenodo record and concept lineage have not been verified; do not use this file to claim a new-version relation until that check is complete. The historical record is listed as provenance. Nielsen is the separately credited author of the included preprint, not a contributor to this compilation. Public-edition PDF built 2026-10-12 from the private full collection (SHA-256 c8417d0a9804a1f42769958962729225e4cda4b79a34aa0d2698c244cd8be218). The reviewed rebuild restores all 6,926 core pages directly from the repository PDF to repair inherited text collisions; 468 surrounding source pages remain unmodified.
